title: How To Get The GTA Online UFO Rewards 2026

content:
It’s almost the end of October 2026 and the UFOs have not appeared in GTA Online like usual. However, a couple of the past rewards are obtainable this week. We’ll be showing you all of what’s on offer and how to get them. The rewards come as part of the latest Event Week.

The UFO event typically starts midway through the month and concludes as Halloween takes place. I have had so much fun over the past several years reporting on the daily UFO locations, escaping the bunker, and even venturing out into Los Santos when the weather went crazy. We’re less than a month away from GTA VI and sadly we aren’t getting another UFO event in GTA V’s Online mode. With all that reminiscing out of the way, let’s unlock some items!

The Shocker

Given out as a UFO event completion reward in 2024, The Shocker is a melee weapon that stuns enemies. It’s a lot of fun to use. When it made its debut in the game a couple of years ago, you had to find it within the Fort Zancudo bunker and escape successfully.

For those that still don’t have it in 2026, Rockstar are giving it away for free. It’s in the Gun Van so simply head on over to the roaming inventory and select it. The weapon is completely free. The Gun Van’s location does change each day so you’ll have to check the map and find where it has spawned.

Gray Space Interloper Outfit

Last year’s reward for escaping the Fort Zancudo bunker was the Gray Space Interloper Outfit. As of October 22nd and through the 28th, you’re able to get it by completing this week’s Weekly Challenge. All you have to do is “Complete all waves of a Survival”. This will gift you GTA$150,000 and the Gray Interloper Outfit.

Even though Halloween has not arrived yet, many fans are speculating that we won’t get the green/orange Halloween weather. There’s still a chance but its likelihood reduces with each passing day. Even though lots of people don’t like the weather (it can be turned off!), we should have it for one last time before GTA VI arrives.
